- Storm fronts made the first march day tense; we need to plan the next weather roll beat for Session 23. - Hester Mull appeared as a courier encounter; unresolved whether the party trusts the detour offer.

- **Raised in Mireward**, not Mirathorn — charter bell, wall walk, downwind fuller's row, ferry steps. - **Ironveil family:** embarrassingly **sincere anti-authoritarian** — toll protest picnics, mock reeve campaigns, optional salutes, **mutual aid sermons at the gate**. Lysandra **shares their beliefs** and **hates their volume**. - **Father Lysandro** — emeritus gate sergeant; **S22 table canon** at Reach Gate. Calls her **Lysa**. **Torr** (grandfather) is the quiet tithe clerk with the framed commendation. - **Left at ~19** for Mirathorn Guard “**one season**”; stayed; **Delwen Rast** (ferry master’s daughter) waited, then married elsewhere. - **Recruited by Commander Thalia Ashenvale** a

- *“Road’s open. Town’s full. I’m not opening for wagons till dawn unless you’re bleeding or useful — and my **daughter** doesn’t count as useful till she says hello to her **father**.”* - *“Write **foot only** — and if the axle folk want a miracle they can lift like the hymn says.”* - On rank: *“You look like you’ve been **eating rank** again.”*

The experience that I want to set up for and I hoep to execute on or generally put in front of the players is to start rapidly upping the pressure. Working to drive them forward at a reckless rate. I want them to have to question whether they can do more "good" or "impact" by staying where they are and helping or if the most effective action is to press on towards the swamp, to try an work out what this drawing Lysandra made is, to get to the swamp.

**Ephanna’s declared intent (end of session):** **Disguise** and a **supply run back to Mossford** — not yet played at the table when Session 20 stopped. Session 21 can open **at that moment** (camp fire, line ringing, storm on the horizon) or **after a short skip** (Ephanna already in town — use `Session 21 - Mossford Saltfen rumor shop.md`).
